name: loongs/orm
description: loong-swoole ORM — Eloquent-style query builder, models and relations; connection chosen per call (name, config array, DSN), always pooled, coroutine-safe

suggest.ext-swoole: Coroutine-local transactions / held connections and pooled named connections
suggest.loongs/framework: Named connections use the framework's Swoole PDOPool (db()) when it is booted
suggest.loongs/saas: Multi-tenancy on top of the ORM: tenant scopes, tenant registry / resolvers, one pool per tenant

scripts.test: php -d disable_functions= tests/orm_test.php cli && php -d disable_functions= tests/orm_test.php co
